title: On the minimum modulus of dual truncated Toeplitz operators
summary: This article provides a systematic investigation of the minimum modulus of dual truncated Toeplitz operators (DTTOs) $D_{\varphi}$ acting on the orthogonal complement of the model space $\mathcal{K}_u^{\perp}$, where $u$ is a nonconstant inner function and $\varphi \in L^\infty(\T)$. We first establish an explicit formula for the minimum modulus of the compressed shift $S_u$ and its dual $D_u$ in terms of $|u(0)|$, and prove that the minimum is always attained.
